reviews.comment: All 6 checklist items pass. repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) correctly prevents content overflow of 1fr tracks. Media query at 800px collapses to single column. applyGridClass() and both call sites cleanly removed. Build clean. Non-blocking: single-project 50% width edge case (pre-existing UX tradeoff) and 800px breakpoint could be wider, both acceptable.
